blocks.heading: Send Us a Message
blocks.subheading: Have a question about our products, need help with your order, or just want to say hello? Fill in the form below and we will get back to you as soon as we can.

blocks.successMessage: Thanks. We aim to reply within 24 hours on weekdays.

blocks.heading: Before you write
blocks.body:
**Response time.** We aim to reply within 24 hours on weekdays. If you message us over the weekend, we will get back to you on Monday.

**Social media.** Follow us on Instagram for growing tips, harvest photos, and behind-the-scenes updates.

**Quick help.** Check our [FAQ](/faq) and [Care Instructions](/care-instructions) for answers to common questions.
